lines: d33: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Patricia Ross is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d33: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d33: 🕯️ Patricia is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
